title: Bay Lights Charters

services.name: Public Sails
services.desc: We understand that not everyone has 49 friends, co-workers or family to book a private Tall Ship Sailing Event. It is with this in mind that we started offering sails on San Francisco Bay with various themes like weekend wine-downs, SF Giants Games, Sunset Sails, Valentines Day Celebrations, Mother and Father’s Day trips or Hump Day sails to get you out on the water! We are constantly adding new trips and new destinations so check back often to see what fun we have planned for you to come aboard! The premise is simple, purchase a ticket or two or ten for you and your desired guests and come sailing aboard our 72-foot Tall Ship Replica Gas Light. These events originate from Richmond, Marina

services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Create a private San Francisco Bay experience aboard one of two distinctive yachts from Bay Lights Charters. Our 72-foot tall ship welcomes up to 49 guests, with wide decks, a comfortable wood-paneled interior, two restrooms, catering options, and a full bar. Guests may help raise the sails, take the helm with our crew’s guidance, or simply relax and enjoy the view. Planning something smaller? Blue Skies offers private power-yacht charters for groups of up to six.
